body.description: Pixel art diorama of a small lived-in refuge at a dungeon entrance, intimate and uneasy. Compact heroic figures, broad connected color clusters, matte materials, crisp stepped edges, selective details, large quiet shadows. 8-12 mismatched mercenaries share bowls, repair equipment and talk in small groups. Bedrolls, patched cloth, a notice board and an unattended ledger show everyday life. Exactly one small mage, STRICTLY SEEN FROM BEHIND, stands apart in deep architectural shadow. Opaque near-black hood and cloak conceal face, skin, hair, hands, age and gender. No one notices, looks at or reacts to the mage. Social warmth belongs to the others; the mage remains outside it. No war, army, ruined city, battle, monsters, magic glow, heroic spotlight, grain, dithering, text or UI. A tiny triangular courtyard wedged between three tall blank walls, viewed steeply from above; roofs removed for a dollhouse cutaway. A diagonal row of patched awnings shelters mercenaries on the far side. The near corner contains a narrow dark landing for the back-facing mage, separated by empty wet paving. Dungeon stairs disappear beneath the lowest awning. No central table or well. Tall thin silhouette with triangular negative space. Desaturated plum shadows, dusty terracotta, parchment fabric, tiny copper lights.
